title: Control Flow
description: If statements, loops, and switch cases in Go
theory:
> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md). Exercise ids are shared across LEARN-* repos for cross-reference.

## Control flow in C#

`if`/`else`, `switch` expressions, `for`, `foreach`, `while`, `break`, and `continue`. Prefer `foreach` for collections.

exercises.title: If Statement
exercises.description: Declare age := 20. If age >= 18, print Adult. Otherwise print Minor.
exercises.starter_code:
var age = 20;
// if (age >= 18) Console.WriteLine("Adult"); else Console.WriteLine("Minor");
hints: Use if age >= 18 { Console.WriteLine("Adult") } else { Console.WriteLine("Minor") }

exercises.title: For Loop
exercises.description: Use a for loop to print numbers 1 through 5.
hints: Use for i := 1; i <= 5; i++ { Console.WriteLine(i) }

exercises.title: Switch Statement
exercises.description: Declare day := 2. Use a switch statement to print the day name: 1=Monday, 2=Tuesday, 3=Wednesday, default=Unknown.
hints: No break statement needed in Go cases

exercises.title: For-Range Loop
exercises.description: Create a slice colors := []string{"red", "green", "blue"}. Use for-range to print each color on its own line.
exercises.starter_code:
var colors = new[] { "red", "green", "blue" };
// foreach (var c in colors) Console.WriteLine(c);
exercises.solution:
var colors = new[] { "red", "green", "blue" };
foreach (var c in colors) Console.WriteLine(c);

exercises.title: Else If Chain
exercises.description: Declare score := 85. Print the grade: 90+ = A, 80+ = B, 70+ = C, 60+ = D, below 60 = F.
exercises.starter_code:
var score = 85;
// chain if / else if for grade
hints: Use if score >= 90 { A } else if score >= 80 { B } ...

exercises.title: For Loop with Break
exercises.description: Use a for loop to count from 1 upward. When i reaches 5, break out of the loop. Print each number before the break.
exercises.starter_code:
var i = 1;
// while / for with break at 5
hints: Use for { } for an infinite loop
if i >= 5 { break } exits the loop

exercises.title: Continue Statement
exercises.description: Use a for loop to print numbers 1 to 10, but skip printing even numbers using continue.
exercises.starter_code: for (var i = 1; i <= 10; i++) { /* skip evens */ }
hints: if i % 2 == 0 { continue } skips even numbers
Check i % 2 != 0 or i % 2 == 1 to print odd numbers
